easy_fields.name: SciQ
easy_fields.creator: Johannes Welbl, Nelson F. Liu, Matt Gardner
easy_fields.publisher: Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (via arXiv)
easy_fields.description: SciQ is a dataset of 13.7K multiple choice science exam questions. It was assembled using a novel crowdsourcing method that leverages a large corpus of domain-specific text and a small set of existing questions. The dataset is intended for research in science exam Question Answering and reading comprehension.
